verdict.rationale: Whether a SaaS email API publishes its source under an open license is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. The pack only shows GitHub repository links for peripheral tools (the MCP server and the CLI). Nothing shows that the core Resend product's source is public, and no open license is mentioned for any repository.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
